ITUK is the only distributor using ACTUAL registered car park data (SMMT/DVLA). All other distributors use IML survival-rate convolution of historical shipment records. ITUK 2024 total: 22,389 vehicles (N-series 21,584 + F-Series 805). This replaces the old Hasegawa estimate of 17,135 — do NOT use 17,135 for any ITUK calculation.

IML provides accumulated Israel UIO up to 2026 only. ISZE's build script (build_isuzu_uio.py) extrapolates 2027–2030 via trend CAGR from the 2023–2026 IML series, capped at ±8%/yr. In the UIO Overview, 2027F–2030F cells for Israel are ISZE estimates, not IML numbers.
ISZE CV plan uses Japanese Fiscal Year (Apr–Mar). FY2025 = CY2025, FY2026 = CY2026, etc. The UIO Overview displays Calendar Years throughout.

Cell B4 in sheet '1.UIO Overview' controls the Grand Total and Growth Rate rows. Set to 'Include' to see all distributors (default). Set to 'Exclude MIDI' to remove MIDI Europe rows (France, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, Poland, Serbia). Row 5 always shows the MIDI contribution regardless of the filter setting.
